name: DevOps, Platform & SRE
tagline: Automate how software is built, shipped and kept running — fast and reliably.

overview.summary: DevOps engineers, platform engineers and Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) make it easy and safe for developers to ship code. They build CI/CD pipelines, manage containers and Kubernetes, automate infrastructure, set up monitoring and on-call, and respond when production breaks. Platform engineering — building an internal 'golden path' so developers can self-serve environments — is the fastest-growing branch of the field.
whyTrending: Industry hiring reports for 2026 list DevOps/platform engineers among the most in-demand tech roles, with US salary bands commonly around $118k–$174k.
AI coding assistants mean teams ship more code, faster — which increases the need for strong pipelines, automated testing and reliable deployments.
Kubernetes and cloud-native tooling (CNCF ecosystem) are now standard in mid-size and large companies, and they need engineers who can run them well.
In Bangladesh, Paylab lists DevOps engineers and SREs among the best-paid IT roles, and offshore firms increasingly sell DevOps-as-a-service to foreign clients.

interview.question: What is CI/CD?
interview.answer: Continuous Integration automatically builds and tests every code change; Continuous Delivery/Deployment automatically releases tested changes to environments, reducing manual, risky releases.

interview.question: Containers vs virtual machines?
interview.answer: VMs virtualise hardware and run a full OS each; containers share the host kernel and package only the app and its dependencies, so they're lighter and start faster.

interview.question: What is a Kubernetes pod and a deployment?
interview.answer: A pod is the smallest deployable unit (one or more containers sharing network/storage). A deployment manages replica pods, rolling updates and rollbacks.

interview.question: What is an SLO and an error budget?
interview.answer: An SLO is a reliability target (e.g. 99.9% successful requests). The error budget is the allowed failure (0.1%); when it's spent, teams slow feature releases to improve reliability.

interview.question: Blue-green vs canary deployment?
interview.answer: Blue-green switches all traffic from old to new environment at once (easy rollback). Canary sends a small share of traffic to the new version first and increases it gradually.

interview.question: What is GitOps?
interview.answer: Using Git as the single source of truth for desired infrastructure and app state; an agent (e.g. Argo CD) continuously syncs the cluster to match Git.

interview.question: How would you debug a pod stuck in CrashLoopBackOff?
interview.answer: Check kubectl describe and logs (including --previous), verify config/secrets, resource limits, health probes and the container's start command.

interview.question: What are the three pillars of observability?
interview.answer: Logs (events), metrics (numeric time series) and traces (request paths across services) — together they explain what is happening and why.

interview.question: What is a blameless postmortem?
interview.answer: An incident review focused on system and process causes, not individuals, producing concrete action items to prevent recurrence.

interview.question: How do you manage secrets in pipelines?
interview.answer: Never commit them; use a secret manager (Vault, cloud secret stores) or encrypted CI secrets, short-lived credentials (OIDC), least privilege and rotation.

demandNotes.bangladesh: High. Offshore software companies, fintech and telecom teams hire DevOps engineers; Kubernetes and AWS experience is especially valued.
demandNotes.remote: High. DevOps is one of the best-paid remote paths for Bangladeshi engineers, though on-call work may require time-zone flexibility.
demandNotes.global: High. Platform engineering and SRE remain core hiring areas as AI increases the volume of code being shipped.
